title: Value Line Automatic & CNC Band Saws, 11-3/4″ to 23-5/8″ (NT-A) | NovoTech Canada
meta_description: NovoTech value-line automatic band saws in Canada: NT-A 12 roller-feed, NT-A 12 SC single-column, NT-A 13 twin-mitre with 20 ft stand and NT-A 14 to NT-A 24 CNC servo saws. Value line, specs in inches and mm.
intro: Automatic saws that feed, clamp, cut and count by themselves — roller feeders on the compact NT-A 12, a hydraulic shuttle vise on the single-column NT-A 12 SC and the twin-mitre NT-A 13, and CNC servo feeding with stepless blade speed on the NT-A 14 to NT-A 24. Value-line pricing with CSA-approved panels, a 1-year warranty and support from Mississauga.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech automatic band saws

faq.q: Roller feed or shuttle vise — which is better?
faq.a: Roller feed (NT-A 12) is simple and fast for bar and tube in straight cuts. A shuttle vise (NT-A 12 SC, NT-A 13) grips the bar and moves it a set distance per stroke, which is more accurate and handles bundles; the CNC saws (NT-A 14 to NT-A 24) position the feeder with a servo motor for the best repeatability.
The NT-A 12 T (0°–60° mitre head), the NT-A 13 (bow swivels both sides) and the NT-A 14, 16 and 18 with an automatic rotary bow (45°; 60° on the NT-A 18).

faq.q: Do automatic saws need a roller table?
faq.a: The NT-A 13 ships with a 20 ft material stand; for the other models a roller conveyor is optional and strongly recommended for bars longer than about 6 ft.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
